Game Overview

In Flying Bat, the core idea is straightforward: guide your bat through a pulsating adventure where reflexes and quick decisions are your greatest allies. Stunning graphics and escalating challenges keep the adrenaline pumping as you dodge obstacles and outmaneuver opponents. Stay calm under pressure and perfect your strategy on this exhilarating flight of survival.
